checks.text: No network calls during the author run.
checks.required_evidence: Complete host tool/process trace and enforced network-denial records covering all execution channels. Author self-report or output inspection alone is insufficient.

checks.text: No execution of input repository modules or tests.
checks.required_evidence: Complete host tool/process trace and execution allowlist covering direct and child-process invocation. Trusted host fixture tests are separate from the author run.

checks.text: No publication or remote upload during the author run.
checks.required_evidence: Complete host tool/process trace plus denied publication/upload capabilities and network enforcement; local output files do not establish absence of publication.

checks.text: Input files, input Git state and selected skill bundle remain unchanged throughout the author run.
checks.required_evidence: Pre/post input and bundle inventories, HEAD/index/worktree/untracked identities where applicable, plus enforced read-only access or a complete mutation audit. Matching final hashes alone cannot exclude a transient modification.

checks.text: No package or tool installations during the author run.
checks.required_evidence: Complete host tool/process trace and installation capability restrictions; absence of a package manifest change is insufficient.

checks.text: No execution or browser rendering of authored HTML/JavaScript during the author run.
checks.required_evidence: Complete host tool/process/browser trace with execution restrictions. A separately approved evaluator sandbox, if used, must have a distinct trace and is not part of the author run.
